get.summary: Search datasets with spatial bounding box filter
get.description:
Extends the core `package_search` action with an `ext_bbox` parameter to filter datasets by spatial extent.

Requires the `spatial_query` and `spatial_metadata` plugins.

**This is not a separate action** — it extends `/api/3/action/package_search` with extra parameter `ext_bbox`.

parameters.name: ext_bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box in the form `minx,miny,maxx,maxy` (WGS84 decimal degrees). Datasets whose `spatial` extra field overlaps this bbox are returned.

parameters.name: ext_prev_extent
parameters.description: Previous map extent `minx,miny,maxx,maxy` for spatial sorting relevance.

200.description: Standard package_search result with spatial filtering applied
